tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Find currently available ordinary and artist cards by occasion, tone, format, artist or budget. Public browsing needs no account or key.

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Prepare one unpaid purchase of 1–500 cards, mixed across any occasions, designs, formats, messages, recipients and dates. One card uses the same cards array. Return per-card previews, the exact sum of current per-card prices, one human review/payment URL and a private order_access_token. No charge o

tools.name: read_order
tools.description: Read a private purchase and its order.cards using the parent order_id and order_access_token. Payment, per-card production and mailing are distinct states.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an eligible purchase at its current revision. Before payment, only whole-purchase cancellation is supported: omit card_ids. After payment, supply returned card_ids to cancel only eligible items, or omit them for the whole eligible purchase. The service verifies ownership and each fulfillment

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
